Title: [JOURNEY] MFA by email — storefront password sign-in, code from email, signed in
Preconditions:
Fixtures are created IN THE CASE (FIFTH RULE) by scripts/seed-data/auth/mfa-fixtures.mjs: the account kind, the store and every flag come from the creator, never from a shared persona; the whole run is removed in Cleanup with teardown(runId). If the creator reports a fixtureGap for the kind this case needs, or the environment touched the state before the step that reads it, the case is BLOCKED, never FAIL.
Sign-in codes are read from the notification journal (MfaSignInEmailNotification for the account) with readLatestMfaCode; SMTP is not relied on, and no code within 90s is BLOCKED.
OPERATOR WINDOW W2 (store): B2B-store {{STORE_ID}} MultiFactorAuthentication.StoreMode = Enabled, set by the operator in Admin (Stores > {{STORE_ID}} > Settings > Security) before the run and restored by the operator after it; the case never writes a setting of {{STORE_ID}} - it only READS the store to assert the window state, and if the store is not in it the case is BLOCKED (needs operator window W2), never FAIL. While the window is open EVERY storefront password sign-in on that store is challenged - run it alone, never beside another suite that signs in on {{STORE_ID}} (104, 031, 032, 082 ...). No global setting is touched.
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
State under test: StoreMode=Enabled on {{STORE_ID}} (operator window W2), global OFF; the account is a confirmed-email customer of {{STORE_ID}} with lockout enabled (kind customer-confirmed), created in the case.
Build under test: deployed theme 2.61.0-pr-2570 with VirtoCommerce.MFA and vc-platform#3133. The code step missing after the password is the defect this journey exists to catch, not a reason to skip.
Test_Data: front={{FRONT_URL}}, back={{BACK_URL}}, store={{STORE_ID}}, admin={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, admin_password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}, password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}
Steps:
--- LAYER: Fixture (REST, created in-case) ---
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token (no MFA setting has been touched yet; keep the token for the whole case)
[SETUP] import scripts/seed-data/auth/mfa-fixtures.mjs: init(); runId = a fresh 3-16 char [a-z0-9] string (it lands in emails, store ids and names)
[SETUP] account = createMfaAccount({runId, store: {id: '{{STORE_ID}}'}, kind: 'customer-confirmed'}) - an @example.com account with password {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}} whose flags the creator verified; capture account.email, account.userId
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer and JSON body {"notificationType":"MfaSignInEmailNotification","keyword":account.email,"sort":"createdDate:desc","take":20}; capture the number of rows as rowsBefore
[SETUP] READ ONLY: GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} with the admin Bearer; read its settings[] entry MultiFactorAuthentication.StoreMode (absent = unset) as modeWindow and require Enabled (operator window W2 is open from here); if it is not Enabled the case is BLOCKED (needs operator window W2: B2B-store StoreMode=Enabled), never FAIL; the case never writes the store
--- SCREEN: Sign in (password) ---
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in in an anonymous browser session
[ACT] Fill [data-test-id="email-input"] with account.email
[ACT] Fill [data-test-id="password-input"] with {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}
[CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the request that should send the code
[ACT] Click [data-test-id="login-button"]
[WAIT] the code step is shown: the heading "Enter the sign-in code" (up to 15s)
--- SCREEN: Enter the sign-in code ---
[ASSERT] The heading reads "Enter the sign-in code", the text reads "We sent a code to" followed by a MASKED address (not the full account.email), six empty code cells and a resend control that counts down ("Resend code in N s")
[ASSERT] The email and password fields are gone, the one-time-code switch link (data-test-id="otp-email-switch-to-otp-link") is not shown, and the header shows no signed-in customer
[CAPTURE] code = readLatestMfaCode({email: account.email, after: T0, excludeIds: the journal rows already read}).code - the 6-digit value in the journal row body
[CAPTURE] rowsAfter = the number of rows of the SAME journal search as rowsBefore (POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer, keyword account.email): poll every 5s for up to 90s until rowsAfter is greater than rowsBefore, then wait 5s and read once more and keep that last value (this read happens before the code is typed, so no later sign-in or resend can add a row)
[ACT] Type the 6 digits of code into 'Code' (sign-in auto-submits on the 6th digit)
[CAPTURE] from the network log: the POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=mfa) request and response as mfaReq, mfaRes; decode the access_token payload and record its amr claim
[WAIT] the page leaves /sign-in
--- SCREEN: Signed in ---
[ASSERT] The account menu shows the signed-in customer of account.email and /sign-in is no longer the current page
[ACT] Reload the page
[ASSERT] The account menu still shows the same signed-in customer (the session is real, not a one-render state)

Sign-in codes are read from the notification journal (MfaSignInEmailNotification for the account) with readLatestMfaCode; SMTP is not relied on, and no code within 90s is BLOCKED.
OPERATOR WINDOW W2 (store): B2B-store {{STORE_ID}} MultiFactorAuthentication.StoreMode = Enabled, set by the operator in Admin (Stores > {{STORE_ID}} > Settings > Security) before the run and restored by the operator after it; the case never writes a setting of {{STORE_ID}} - it only READS the store to assert the window state, and if the store is not in it the case is BLOCKED (needs operator window W2), never FAIL. While the window is open EVERY storefront password sign-in on that store is challenged - run it alone, never beside another suite that signs in on {{STORE_ID}} (104, 031, 032, 082 ...). No global setting is touched.
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
State under test: StoreMode=Enabled on {{STORE_ID}}, global OFF; a confirmed-email customer of {{STORE_ID}} created in the case. Wrong codes count toward the cap of 3: the case submits at most two wrong ones before the real code.
